overall: Actual current-result payment/pending/unpaid/recorded status connected to existing result and final-growth UI. Original settlement/atomic persistence/retry/admission/navigation rules retained. Full Godot3527/GUI129/24separate-process restore PASS;mobile/finalart-audio/economy approval separate.

implementation.formatter: reward_payment.gd is stateless/read-only. References original RunState.Phase enum,matching durable pending runID/phase/end_reason/mode/stage/collected gold plus loaded account current campaign last_run/nextstage or dungeon closedID/outcome/reward. No constructor/fileIO/settle/commit/RNG/timer or new stored state.
implementation.status: Paid requires matching current terminal snapshot and actual account record with successful relevant operations. Generic success/settings persistence/another run/another snapshot cannot claim paid. Missing credit is pending with quoted reward and last-confirmed balance;unreadable account has unknown balance. Prior matching credit with later save failure is recorded-but-needs-confirmation,not a false promise of another payout.
implementation.nonclear: Defeat/timeout/forfeit still reward0. Dungeon entry close confirmation is separate from unpaid reward:closed0record versus pendingclose. Campaign unlock/daily charge/no refund/clearbonus and reward rates unchanged.
implementation.ui: Main.gd replaces only its two reward append strings with one virtual text formatter. Existing settlement branches,return/error handling/controlbindings remain byte-identical when these text hooks are reversed. Mobile uses existing result label,exposes same receipt in existing final-growth overview and names that button finalgrowth/reward details. No new payment modal/confirmation. Existing primary battle/account retry is moved immediately below heading to remain visible on compact screens.
implementation.recovery: Original retries/cold terminal recovery/idempotent run IDs do all writes. Opening final overview is read-only. Restored paid and pending results reach the existing lobby without automatic newbattle;final overview still shows the confirmed frozen outcome. Clarify the old no-permanent-archive caption as growth-record scope,not an assertion that currency is unsaved.
implementation.ownership: 69other production/data/assets files including RunState/Cues/View/progression/GoldProgress/RunStore/Snapshot/audio and original guard unchanged. SingleRunState/save15/7RNG/economy/6min3min/daily2/HP/XP/spawns/MP40/4+4/art unchanged.

static_integrity.scope: UTF-8, delimiters, whitespace, JSON/Python syntax, resource existence, project settings; NOT GDScript parser/typechecking or gameplay.

growth_data_contract.scope: JSON schema/content and source integration markers only; not GDScript runtime/behavior.

magic_data_contract.scope: JSON validation, negative data controls and source markers/arithmetic; NOT GDScript runtime, UI, input dispatch or mobile tests.

feedback_source_contract.scope: 7 affected code/test/checker files: UTF-8, delimiters, whitespace, Python syntax, reaction constants, integration markers, engine-test registration and new dependency paths only. NOT the full project check or GDScript parser/type/runtime, rendering, or mobile input tests.

mobile_hud_source_contract.scope: Changed UTF-8 files, delimiters, Python syntax and integration source checks only. NOT GDScript parsing/typechecking, actual Control geometry, touch dispatch, rendering or mobile execution.

run_navigation_source_contract.scope: UTF-8/delimiters/Python syntax and navigation SOURCE contracts only; NOT GDScript parsing/types, native execution, actual UI/input, or mobile testing.

combat_cues_source_contract.scope: Changed-source UTF-8/delimiters/Python syntax, hook order, bounds, isolation, reviewed GAME-024 RunState/GAME-030 view baselines with exact GAME-033 read-only adapters and preserved engine runner. NOT Godot parser/type/runtime, visual quality, input dispatch, or FPS.

godot_runtime.scope: headless import, actual foundation/growth/magic/feedback/mobile-HUD/run-navigation/combat-cues GDScript tests and main boot; visual/mobile approval separate

source_proof.ownership: Original RunState/Cues/Main persistence and settlement flow,GoldProgress/RunStore/Snapshot/data/assets/audio remain unchanged. Only result text hook and mobile display/recovery-control placement/final-overview content change.

gui.scope: Actual X11/current-result paid/pending/unpaid/recorded,real writes/native retries/overview/forfeit plus inherited gameplay/UI regression. Receipt values,clock jumps and previous crowd/pose fixtures are QA,not new natural income/campaign/device proof.
